spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Total",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wraparound) AS "Anti-wraparound",
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(
      SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at)))
      / (($__to - $__from) / 1000.0),
      0
    ),
    1
  ) AS "Avg. workers"
FROM pganalyze.vacuum_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at);

spec.title: Transaction ID Utilization
spec.description: How much transaction ID space is utilized among the actual maximum available transaction IDs, in percent.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * age(datfrozenxid) / 4294967296, 4) AS xid_utilization_percent
FROM pg_database
WHERE datname = current_database()

SELECT
    n.nspname || '.' || c.relname AS "Table",
    COUNT(*) AS "Count",
    SUM(v.tuples_removed) || ' (' ||
    ROUND(
        SUM(v.tuples_removed)
        / NULLIF(SUM(v.tuples_removed + v.tuples_remain), 0) * 100.0,
        2
    ) || '%)' AS "Tuples removed",
    SUM(v.index_scans) AS "Index scans",
    SUM(v.pages_removed) AS "Pages removed",
    MAX(v.finished_at - v.started_at) AS "Max duration",
    MAX(v.finished_at) AS "Last vacuum"
FROM pganalyze.vacuum_stats v
JOIN pg_class c
    ON c.oid = v.hypertable_relid
JOIN pg_namespace n
    ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
GROUP BY
    v.hypertable_relid,
    n.nspname,
    c.relname
ORDER BY SUM(v.tuples_removed) DESC

spec.title: Xmin Horizon Assigned
spec.description: How long ago the xmin horizon was assigned, indicating up to which point VACUUM can clean up dead rows.

spec.rawSql:
WITH current_horizon AS (
  SELECT
    xmin_horizon
  FROM
    pganalyze.database_stats
  WHERE
    xmin_horizon <> 0
  ORDER BY
    collected_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MIN(ds.collected_at))) AS assigned_seconds_ago
FROM
  pganalyze.database_stats ds
  CROSS JOIN current_horizon ch
WHERE
  ds.xmin_horizon = ch.xmin_horizon;

WITH threshold AS (
  SELECT setting::bigint AS "autovacuum_freeze_max_age"
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name ='autovacuum_freeze_max_age'
)

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  frozen_xid_age,
  (SELECT autovacuum_freeze_max_age FROM threshold) AS autovacuum_freeze_max_age
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
ORDER BY collected_at

WITH threshold AS (
  SELECT setting::bigint AS "autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age"
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name ='autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age'
)

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  frozen_mxid_age,
  (SELECT autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age FROM threshold) AS autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
ORDER BY collected_at

spec.title: Max I/O impact
spec.description: Theoretical maximum impact that VACUUM can have on your system

spec.rawSql:
WITH settings AS (
  SELECT
    (CASE 
       WHEN (SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit') = '-1'
       THEN (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_limit')
       ELSE (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit')
     END) AS vacuum_cost_limit_effective,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_page_miss') AS vacuum_cost_page_miss,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_page_dirty') AS vacuum_cost_page_dirty,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay') AS autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay,
    8192 AS block_size_bytes -- 8kB block size
)
SELECT
  (vacuum_cost_limit_effective / vacuum_cost_page_miss * block_size_bytes / autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay) * 1000 AS "read",
  (vacuum_cost_limit_effective / vacuum_cost_page_dirty * block_size_bytes / autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay) * 1000 AS "write"
FROM settings

spec.title: Index bloat info
spec.description: Per-index bloat estimates. For hypertables we only consider uncompressed chunks. Indexes with no bloat are filtered out.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  indexrelname AS "Index name",
  schema_name AS "Schema",
  table_name AS "Table",
  real_size_bytes AS "Size",
  bloat_size_bytes AS "Est. bloat",
  bloat_ratio_percent AS "Est. bloat %"
FROM
  pganalyze.index_bloat
ORDER BY
  bloat_ratio_percent DESC

spec.title: Est. Table Bloat
spec.description: The estimated overall table bloat on this  database - this is a very rough estimate and should be reviewed for individual tables. Compressed chunks are excluded and only tables > 1MB are considered.

spec.title: Total tables
spec.description: The total number of tables on this database - databases with a lot of tables can often times suffer from more autovacuum scheduling challenges.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tables
FROM pg_class c

SELECT
    name,
    setting
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name IN (
    'autovacuum_max_workers',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold',
    'autovacuum_freeze_max_age',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor',
    'autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor',
    'autovacuum_naptime',
    'autovacuum_work_mem'
  )

spec.title: Table bloat info
spec.description: Per-table bloat estimates, as calculated by the difference of the actual table size, compared to the average row size * number of rows in the table. For hypertables we only consider uncompressed chunks. Tables with no bloat are filtered out.

spec.rawSql:
WITH table_options AS (
  SELECT
    n.nspname AS schemaname,
    c.relname AS tblname,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          option_value :: numeric
        FROM
          pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions)
        WHERE
          option_name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor'
      ),
      current_setting('autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor') :: numeric
    ) AS vacuum_scale_factor,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          option_value :: numeric
        FROM
          pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions)
        WHERE
          option_name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold'
      ),
      current_setting('autovacuum_vacuum_threshold') :: numeric
    ) AS vacuum_threshold,
    c.reltuples :: numeric AS row_count
  FROM
    pg_class c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE
    c.relkind IN ('r', 'm')
    AND n.nspname NOT SIMILAR TO '(pg_catalog|information_schema|_timescaledb_c%)'
    AND c.relname NOT SIMILAR TO '(%compress%|bgw%)'
)
SELECT
  b.schema_name AS "Schema",
  b.table_name AS "Table",
  b.real_size_bytes AS "Size",
  b.bloat_size_bytes AS "Est. bloat",
  b.bloat_ratio_percent AS "Est. bloat %",
  opt.vacuum_scale_factor AS "Scale factor",
  opt.vacuum_threshold AS "Threshold",
  st.last_autovacuum AS "Last vacuum"
FROM
  pganalyze.table_bloat b
  JOIN table_options opt ON opt.schemaname = b.schema_name
  AND opt.tblname = b.table_name
  LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables st ON st.schemaname = b.schema_name
  AND st.relname = b.table_name
ORDER BY
  b.bloat_ratio_percent DESC

spec.title: Next anti-wraparound vacuum
spec.description: Minimum time until any table reaches its anti-wraparound VACUUM threshold - this is a function of the rate of transaction ID consumption and the autovacuum_freeze_max_age setting. Higher values are better.

spec.rawSql:
WITH current_stats AS (
  SELECT
    collected_at,
    xact_commit + xact_rollback AS total_transactions,
    LAG(xact_commit + xact_rollback, 144) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        collected_at
    ) AS transactions_24h_ago,
    LAG(collected_at, 144) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        collected_at
    ) AS collected_at_24h_ago
  FROM
    pganalyze.database_stats
),
params AS (
  SELECT
    (
      total_transactions - transactions_24h_ago
    ) :: numeric / NULLIF(
      EXTRACT(
        EPOCH
        FROM
          (
            collected_at - collected_at_24h_ago
          )
      ),
      0
    ) AS tx_per_sec,
    current_setting('autovacuum_freeze_max_age') :: bigint AS freeze_max_age,
    current_setting('autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age') :: bigint AS multixact_freeze_max_age
  FROM
    current_stats
  WHERE
    collected_at = (
      SELECT
        MAX(collected_at)
      FROM
        pganalyze.database_stats
    )
    AND transactions_24h_ago IS NOT NULL
),
tables AS (
  SELECT
    c.oid :: regclass :: text AS table_name,
    LEAST(
      p.freeze_max_age - age(c.relfrozenxid),
      p.multixact_freeze_max_age - mxid_age(c.relminmxid)
    ) AS tx_before_wraparound_vacuum
  FROM
    pg_class c
    CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE
    c.relfrozenxid != 0
    AND c.oid > 16384
),
minimum AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(tx_before_wraparound_vacuum) AS min_tx_before_wraparound
  FROM
    tables
)
SELECT
  min_tx_before_wraparound / NULLIF(p.tx_per_sec, 0) / 3600.0 AS min_hours_until_anti_wraparound_vacuum
FROM
  minimum
  CROSS JOIN params p;

spec.title: Transaction ID Allocation
spec.description: The rate of transaction IDs that are allocated per minute, as averaged over the last 24 hours. Higher allocation rates generally mean more freezing will be required.

spec.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (
    SELECT
        collected_at,
        xact_commit + xact_rollback AS total_transactions,
        LAG(xact_commit + xact_rollback, 144) OVER (
            ORDER BY collected_at
        ) AS transactions_24h_ago,
        LAG(collected_at, 144) OVER (
            ORDER BY collected_at
        ) AS collected_at_24h_ago
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
)
SELECT
    collected_at AS time,
    ROUND(
        (
            total_transactions - transactions_24h_ago
        )::numeric
        /
        NULLIF(
            EXTRACT(
                EPOCH FROM (collected_at - collected_at_24h_ago)
            ) / 60.0,
            0
        ),
        2
    ) AS txn_per_minute_24h_avg
FROM samples
WHERE transactions_24h_ago IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY collected_at

spec.name: min_relpages

spec.query:
WITH object_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS objects_count
    FROM pg_class
),
settings AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN objects_count > 100000 THEN 2500
            WHEN objects_count >= 10000 THEN 250
            ELSE 0
        END AS default_min_relpages
    FROM object_count
)
SELECT default_min_relpages
FROM settings
